extracted.name: An Authenticity of Indonesian Fried Noodle
extracted.description: It is one of Indonesian instant fried noodle called Mie Goreng Sedap that i cook by my way without follow the intruction in the package. But i use all the seasoning of this noodle. I add some garlic, scrambled egg and chicken. It would be nice also if we add some vegetables. But this time i didn't. #mycookbook
ingredient_lines: All seasoning of Mie Goreng Sedap
instruction_lines: Boil noodle about 3 to 5 minutes or according to the intruction. Drained it and set aside
Heat a pan and make scramble egg,take out from the pan and set aside

In the same pan heat olive oil, fry garlic untill fragrant and add chicken cook untill cooked well, (i use left over lastnight hainan chicken). Add scrambled egg, add sweet soy sauce, tomato chili sauce, chili powder and stir well
Next put in noodle, add all instant noodle seasoning and mix well, and it has been done, and finally ready to serve.. nom nom 🥰
